user.title: Cumulus PV controller
user.description: Select the ESPHome entities and up to seven daily PV production forecasts. The planner compares forecast production with estimated household use and water-heater energy, then stores heat ahead of forecast shortages. It keeps the base target when forecasts are sufficient, and only raises it for a shortage that is economically worthwhile after estimated tank losses.

data.consumption_forecast: Remaining household consumption forecast excluding water heater (kWh)
data.house_energy: Total home energy meter (including water heater)
data.wait_for_peak: Wait for the PV peak window
data.daily_house_consumption_kwh: Fallback daily home energy excluding water heater (kWh)
data.boost_offset_max_c: Maximum temperature boost for forecast shortage (°C)
data.tank_loss_pct_per_day: Estimated tank heat loss per day (%)
data.recovery_value_pct: Value of avoided future energy cost (% of base price)
data.export_value_pct: Value of exported energy (% of base price)

data_description.pv_priority_switch: This switch enables the Home Assistant duty command in the ESPHome controller. Turn it off to return to the local thermostat.
data_description.pv_surplus: Used when no valid grid export sensor is selected.
data_description.grid_export: Positive when exporting power. If selected, this takes priority over the net PV surplus sensor.
data_description.grid_import: Positive when importing power; subtracted from grid export to estimate net surplus.
data_description.consumption_forecast: Use a forecast of remaining household consumption excluding the water heater.
data_description.pv_forecast: Select a sensor for the remaining PV production today, in kWh.
data_description.pv_forecast_d1: Select a sensor for the PV production forecast tomorrow, in kWh.
data_description.heater_command: Use the ESPHome number entity configured as cumulus.heater_command (0–100%).
data_description.house_energy: Optional cumulative whole-home energy meter, including the water heater. Supports Wh, kWh, or MWh; daily use is learned from meter changes.
data_description.heater_energy: Optional cumulative water-heater energy meter. Supports Wh, kWh, or MWh; daily use is learned from complete days.
data_description.daily_consumption_kwh: Fallback used until a complete daily consumption history is available. If no energy meter is selected, consumption is estimated from measured heater power or configured element power and HA duty.
data_description.daily_house_consumption_kwh: Used until the home and water-heater meters have enough history. When both are configured, their measured difference is used instead.
data_description.forecast_margin_pct: Reduces forecast PV production to account for forecast uncertainty.
data_description.tank_loss_pct_per_day: Approximate fraction of stored heat lost each day; tune to the tank's real insulation and installation.
data_description.recovery_value_pct: Set to 50% when each kWh avoided from the grid saves only the transport charge, which is half the base price.
data_description.export_value_pct: Set this to the effective value of exporting one kWh instead of keeping it as heat. Forecast preheating is skipped when export value exceeds avoided cost after tank losses.

error.no_surplus_source: Select a PV surplus sensor or a grid export sensor.
error.invalid_temperature_limits: The base target must be above the minimum and at or below the maximum temperature.
error.invalid_peak_window: The PV window start and end hours must differ.

init.title: Cumulus PV controller
init.description: Update the ESPHome entities, PV sources, and energy-planning settings. The planner leaves the base target unchanged when PV forecasts are sufficient and stores only the thermal reserve justified by forecast shortages, uncertainty, tank losses, and energy value.
